title: Optimizer v1: genome, compile-informed surrogate, MAP-Elites archive over all roles, render ladder and a rated cycle folder (Ave House)
description: Spec section 7 Phase 1, widened by the user's decision to all roles (loop, bass, pad, stab, chop, sliced riff) and CLAP as a taste/genre term (from the sidecar task). Add-a-part by default; --role <existing> re-casts. Acceptance: (1) reproducible with --seed; (2) surrogate vs rendered composite Spearman >= 0.6 and recall@12 >= 0.75 per role on Ave House; (3) the null control is always in L1 and no finalist beats it by < 2; (4) positive controls: incumbent's own loop ranks top 3, a forced +1 semitone ranks below it, a silent candidate is gated; (5) <= 15 min per cycle with 4 workers; (6) output folder cycle.json + A-D .apr/.m4a ready for scripts/cycle.py publish. Blocked by apricitus-ab3291 and the sidecar task for stab/chop density and CLAP.
